text: To go wrong in one's own way is better than to go right in *someone else's*.
We suffer more often in imagination than in *reality*.
You must learn to enjoy life without needing an *audience* to see that you are enjoying life.
You have mistaken comfort for peace for so long that discipline now feels like *suffering*.
If it makes you happy, take the risk. Worst case, you learn. Best case, you change your *whole life*.
The universe is not on a budget. Ask for *more*.
People who truly like themselves are ruthless with *access*.
What's not meant for you will disappoint you a thousand times until you *understand*.
Be so busy watering your own grass that you don't have time to check if someone else's is *greener*.
If it's out of your control, it needs to be out of your *mind*.
A man ruled by his emotions is a slave to any stranger who knows which *button* to press.
Ships don't sink because of the water around them. They sink because of the water that gets *in* them.
Until death, all defeat is *psychological*.
Anxiety is the dizziness of *freedom*.
It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear *never beginning to live*.
A book must be the axe for the *frozen sea* within us.
All of humanity's problems stem from man's inability to sit quietly in a room *alone*.
No one can build you the bridge on which you, and *only you*, must cross the river of life.
The art of being wise is the art of knowing what to *overlook*.
He who is everywhere is *nowhere*.
The cost of a thing is the amount of *life* which is required to be exchanged for it.
